title: OKX Referral Code: What It Unlocks and How to Use It
intro_chapter: What the OKX referral code is

scenes.title: OKX referral code
scenes.sub: What it unlocks, step by step

media.image_prompt: close-up of a hand holding a smartphone in a dim modern room, violet and blue reflections, bokeh lights, cinematic

lines.show: The OKX referral code is a short code you type once, when you create your account.
It links your new account to the person who invited you, and it can make you eligible for new user rewards.
In this video: what the code does, where to enter it, and what to check before you sign up.

scenes.title: A link between two accounts
scenes.text: The inviter and the new user are connected.

alt: two people looking at phone screen

lines.show: Think of a referral code as a label on your sign-up.
It tells OKX that someone invited you to the platform.
That link is created once, at registration, and it stays with the account.

scenes.title: Does it change your account?
scenes.text: Your account works the same way.

lines.show: A common question: does a referral code change how your account works?
No. You get the same app, the same security settings, and the same fee pages as everyone else.
The code only connects you to a referrer and to any welcome program running for new users.

scenes.title: Rewards change over time
scenes.text: The current offer is shown in the app.

lines.show: New user offers change often, and they can differ by country.
So the current welcome rewards are shown in the app's rewards page, with their own terms.
Read that page yourself before you decide anything.
Here is the usual order of steps.
First, install the official OKX app from your phone's app store.
Tap Sign up and enter your email or phone number.
Look for the referral or invite code field. It is often marked as optional.
Type the code XOACPQFC exactly, letter by letter.
Then finish the identity verification steps.

scenes.title: Do it before you finish
scenes.text: Adding a code later is not always possible.

lines.show: Timing matters here.
Enter the code before you complete registration, because adding one later is not always possible.

scenes.title: Check the code field twice
scenes.text: One wrong letter means no link.

lines.show: Before you tap continue, read the code field once more.
One wrong letter and the link to your referrer is not created.

scenes.title: Three quick checks
items: OKX is available where you live

lines.show: Run these three checks first.
One: make sure OKX is available where you live. Some countries have limits.
Two: download only the official app, never a file from a message or a random site.
Three: read the terms on the rewards page, including deadlines and tasks.

scenes.title: Nobody needs your password
scenes.text: Real support never asks for it.

lines.show: One more safety note.
A referral code is public. Your password and verification codes are not.
Never share them with anyone who says they will set up your account for you.
After you sign up, turn on two-factor authentication in the security settings.
It takes a minute, and it protects your account if a password leaks.

scenes.title: OKX referral code
scenes.text: Type it in the referral field at sign-up

lines.show: So here is the code again: XOACPQFC.
Type it in the referral field when you create your OKX account.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, use code XOACPQFC at sign-up.
Check the rewards page in the app before you start.
The sign-up link is in the description.
Thanks for watching.
